statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCICompartment)-[:RESOURCE]->(m)-[r:TAGGED]->(:OCITag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCICompartment)-[:RESOURCE]->(:OCIKmsVault)-[:OCI_KMS_KEY]->(m:OCIKmsKey)-[r:TAGGED]->(:OCITag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCICompartment)-[:RESOURCE]->(:OCIDbSystem)-[:HAS_DB_HOME]->(m:OCIDbHome)-[r:TAGGED]->(:OCITag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCICompartment)-[:RESOURCE]->(:OCILogGroup)-[:OCI_LOG]->(m:OCILog)-[r:TAGGED]->(:OCITag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:OCICompartment)-[:RESOURCE]->()-[:OCI_VOLUME_BACKUP]->(m:OCIVolumeBackup)-[r:TAGGED]->(:OCITag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
MATCH (n:OCITag) WHERE NOT (n)--() AND n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
